dnsName.description: Alias resource record sets only: The external DNS name associated with the AWS Resource.

isEvaluateHealthTarget.description: Alias resource record sets only: A boolean value that indicates whether this Resource Record Set should respect the health status of any health checks associated with the ALIAS target record which it is linked to.

hostedZoneID.description: Alias resource record sets only: The value of the hosted zone ID for the AWS resource.
